name: bento-grid

frames.best_why: All four cards and their preview visuals are fully visible with no cursor in the way.

tagline: Four black feature tiles with tiny terminals, code and UI previews inside.
summary: An asymmetric grid of black feature cards, each pairing a small visual with an icon, title and description. Two wide cards and two narrow ones form a bento layout that reacts to hover.
appearance: A four-cell bento of black rounded cards: a wide top-left card with a tiny terminal and purple glow, a narrow top-right with a code snippet, a bottom-left card with coloured tiles, and a wide bottom card showing two small light and dark UI panels on a grey gradient.
behaviour: Static at rest. Hovering a card slides its icon and text right, adds a shadow and runs small changes inside: the purple glow brightens, the coloured tiles resize, and the two panels tilt apart.
demo_content: Four cards: Ship at the speed of thought, Type-safe by default, Composable primitives, Dark mode included.
search_phrases: grid of feature cards with previews
use_when: Presenting four different product strengths side by side with a small visual for each.
avoid_when: A uniform grid: each card needs a span class, so equal sizing takes source edits.
customise: Each cell takes a title, description, header node, icon node and className for its span; grid columns and row height are set on the container.
weight_why: Four CSS grid cells with hover transitions only; no scripted animation.

a11y.note: Nothing here is operable, so keyboard and focus do not apply; the preview visuals are plain divs.

issues: Preview text inside the cards is 11px, hard to read at a glance.
In frame 4 the bottom-left card's title wraps while its neighbours stay on one line.
Hover changes are subtle; frames 1 and 6 look nearly identical.
polish_why: Neat bento composition with believable previews; the tiny monospace text is hard to read.
